name: FateCat live release evidence gate
scope: remote GitHub Actions evidence for current commit
Hugging Face Space hosted Web live smoke

requiredEvidence.name: Local quick CI summary
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 只记录命令、路径、commit 和摘要，不复制测试日志全文或用户报告

requiredEvidence.name: Remote GitHub Actions run for current commit
acceptedEvidence: run head SHA equals current commit
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 只记录 run URL 和 commit，不读取 GitHub secrets

requiredEvidence.name: Production API live smoke
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 只请求健康检查和指标入口，不提交用户出生信息或报告正文

requiredEvidence.name: Hugging Face Space live smoke
acceptedEvidence: https://<owner>-<space>.hf.space/web returns 2xx and contains FateCat/Web form marker
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 只请求公开 /web，不提交用户输入

requiredEvidence.name: Telegram Bot live smoke
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 不输出 Bot token，只输出 Telegram 返回的非敏感 bot id/username

requiredEvidence.name: Container release digest
acceptedEvidence: container evidence pushExecuted=false for local baseline
sha256:<64 hex> registry image digest for true production release
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 只记录 image digest，不记录 registry token

requiredEvidence.name: SBOM artifact
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: SBOM 不得包含 secret；gate 只验证 artifact 存在或 URL 形态

requiredEvidence.name: Release provenance artifact
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: provenance 只记录构建来源、commit 和 artifact digest，不记录 secret

requiredEvidence.name: Rollback drill evidence
acceptedEvidence: rollback drill mode=dry-run for local baseline
operator-signed runbook evidence for true production rollback drill
requiredEvidence.privacyBoundary: 回滚演练证据不得包含生产用户输入、token 或私有日志

requiredEvidence.name: Clean release git state
acceptedEvidence: git status --short --branch shows clean release commit

externalVerification: bash scripts/live-release-gate.sh --require-live --api-url <真实API域名> --hf-space-url <真实HF Space URL> --run-live-bot --output-json <path>

blockingItems: 远端 GitHub Actions 当前 commit 证据待执行
真实生产 API /health /ready /metrics 待执行
真实 Hugging Face Space /web 待执行
真实 Telegram Bot live smoke 待执行
GHCR container digest、GitHub attestation、SBOM/provenance artifact 和 rollback drill artifact 待提供
当前 worktree 未提交前不得宣称可发布
shipGate.policy: 本地 gate 可证明发布准入口径完整；只有全部 requiredEvidence 为 pass 且 git clean 时，live release shipGate 才能 pass。

metadata.policy: 不伪造 live evidence；无真实外部资源时输出 pending/blocked，而不是通过。
metadata.privacy: ReleaseGate 不输出真实 token、secret、DSN、私钥、用户出生资料、报告正文或生产日志正文。
